Class PanelRendering

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.core.PanelRendering
public final class PanelRendering extends Object
Static rendering utilities for PanelStyle backgrounds and slot backgrounds. The PanelStyle enum is declarative metadata ("what does this panel look like"); this class is the imperative renderer ("draw it like this").

Sprite-based styles (RAISED, DARK) use vanilla's 9-slice blitSprite with MenuKit-owned texture assets. Programmatic styles (INSET) draw themselves with fills, matching vanilla's inventory panel look.

Part of the canonical MenuKit hierarchy: Screen → Panel → SlotGroup → MKCSlot

  • Method Details

    • renderPanel

      public static void renderPanel(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor graphics, int x, int y, int w, int h, PanelStyle style)
      Renders a panel background at the given position and size. RAISED and DARK use 9-slice sprites; INSET renders programmatically with default panel colors; NONE renders nothing.

    • renderPanel

      public static void renderPanel(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor graphics, int x, int y, int w, int h, PanelStyle style, int baseColor, int highlightColor, int shadowColor)
      Renders a panel background with custom colors and the default black border. Programmatic styles (INSET, RAISED fallback) use these colors; sprite-based styles ignore them.

    • renderPanel

      public static void renderPanel(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor graphics, int x, int y, int w, int h, PanelStyle style, int baseColor, int highlightColor, int shadowColor, int borderColor)
      Renders a panel background with fully-custom colors including border. The entry point for callers that want programmatic rendering with state-dependent colors (e.g., hover/press states on buttons).

    • renderSlotBackground

      public static void renderSlotBackground(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor graphics, int x, int y)
      Renders a vanilla-accurate 18×18 slot background at the given position. Matches vanilla exactly — no outer black border, just inner highlight/shadow edges with a medium gray fill.

    • renderInsetRect

      public static void renderInsetRect(net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor graphics, int x, int y, int w, int h)
      Renders a vanilla-accurate inset rectangle of arbitrary dimensions — same shadow/highlight/fill pattern as slot backgrounds, but for non-slot recessed regions (scrollbar tracks, custom recessed inset areas). Lighter-weight than PanelStyle.INSET (no outer black border + heavy bevel) — matches vanilla's subtle recess for tracks and similar narrow inset chrome.
